description: Use this when someone asks for a listed company's investor presentation, corporate deck or earnings slides, or how its deck has changed. Give it the company's ticker or name. Returns its decks newest first, each with date, slide count, a line on what changed from the previous version and its 6ix.com link, and how many decks 6ix holds for it; read a deck's slides with get_deck, and pass nextCursor as cursor for older decks.

company.description: Ticker (AAPL, NYSE:BAC, SHOP.TO), company name, or the 6ix company link returned by find_company

cursor.description: To read on: nextCursor from this tool's last answer, exactly as given, with the same other arguments

page.description: Page 2 and on go further back in time

name: get_company_decks

whatChanged.description: What changed from the company's previous version of this deck

hasMore.description: More follow: ask again with cursor set to nextCursor

listChanged.description: The list changed since the cursor was made and the last item shown is no longer in it, so an item may repeat or be missed here

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor to read on from the last item shown; null at the end

page.description: The page read; null when read on from a cursor

total.description: Decks 6ix holds for the company, dated today or earlier

title: Decks from a company
